facts.claim: 经纪人 Rhonda 趁合同时间紧迫，在周四上午谈成一笔大单。
facts.quote: to score a phenomenal deal by Thursday morning

facts.claim: Belle 给早年那位靠收购私营监狱发家的客户发邮件，请他帮忙牵线亚利桑那的监狱。
facts.quote: I shot him an e-mail anyway, to see if he could put me in touch

facts.claim: 对方不到一小时就回了一个 Zoom 链接，Belle 收到后十分钟内点了进去。
facts.quote: he replied to my e-mail in under an hour with a Zoom link

facts.claim: 镜头里的男人举起证件，是 Dead Horse 监狱的狱警 Luke Fulton。
facts.quote: LUKE FULTON, I read. CORRECTIONS OFFICER.

facts.claim: Luke 喝着水说自己干这行十五年，始终待在同一所监狱。
facts.quote: his huge Adam’s apple bobbing up and down. “Fifteen years.”

facts.claim: Luke 告诉 Belle，Deirdre Gregory 已获假释，明天就出狱。
Belle 问那两人是否提过 Eli Pratt，Luke 摇头说从没提过。
两人交换了手机号，Belle 随即结束 Zoom 通话。
facts.quote: We exchanged phone numbers, and then I got off Zoom

relations.rel: 初次视频接触的写手与狱警，彼此有好感

relations.quote: while he nodded for a third time.

relations.rel: 狱警与在押囚犯（分开关押，从不照面）

relations.quote: Austin was twenty when he married Deirdre
the one who had held the knife to young Genevieve’s throat
my next project is with Genevieve Caraway

relations.rel: 代笔人与早年的监狱大亨客户
relations.quote: One of my earliest was a man who amassed a fortune taking over numerous private prisons

numbers.claim: Rhonda 谈成合同的时间：周四上午
numbers.quote: to score a phenomenal deal by Thursday morning

numbers.claim: Belle 固定通电话的人一只手数得过来
numbers.quote: I can count on one hand the number of people I speak to on the phone

numbers.claim: Belle 在缅因任务失败后写出的推理小说数量
numbers.quote: I’d produced those two mystery novels in the interim

numbers.quote: he replied to my e-mail in under an hour with a Zoom link

numbers.claim: Belle 收到链接后点进去的间隔
numbers.quote: which was less than ten minutes after I received it

numbers.claim: Belle 估计 Luke 的年龄

numbers.quote: his huge Adam’s apple bobbing up and down. “Fifteen years.”

numbers.claim: 斯坦福监狱实验发生的年代

numbers.quote: They were supposed to act out their roles for two weeks
Except it didn’t even last a week

numbers.claim: Deirdre 满十八岁即嫁给 Austin
numbers.quote: as soon as she turned eighteen
Austin was twenty when he married Deirdre

numbers.claim: Genevieve 被囚在盐湖城公寓的时长

numbers.quote: all this happened twenty years ago

numbers.claim: Rhonda 的警告：被骗三次就得换经纪人
numbers.quote: Fool me three times? You’re going to need a new agent.

turning_point: Luke 在通话末尾透露 Deirdre Gregory 已获假释、明天出狱，Belle 由此看到采访她的新门路。
notes: 1) “a million logistics”“a few months”等为夸张/模糊说法，未计入 numbers。2) King of Cages 是书名式绰号，未给出真名。3) 本章未出现具体钟点；Luke 的“Long weekend”只是休假说法。4) Luke 全名与职务来自其举起的证件（LUKE FULTON / CORRECTIONS OFFICER），非口头自述。
